questions.question_text: The prime factorisation of 140 is:
Check whether 6^n can end with digit 0 for any natural number n.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: 6^n = (2 * 3)^n. Prime factor 5 is absent. By FTA uniqueness, 6^n never ends in 0.

questions.question_text: Find HCF and LCM of 12, 15, and 21 using prime factorisation method.
Prove that √2 is irrational using proof by contradiction.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Assume √2 = a/b (coprime). 2b^2 = a^2 => 2 divides a => a = 2c => 2b^2 = 4c^2 => b^2 = 2c^2 => 2 divides b. Contradiction! Hence √2 is irrational.

questions.question_text: A seminar has 60 participants in Hindi, 84 in English, and 108 in Mathematics. Find minimum number of rooms needed if each room seats equal participants of same subject.

Prove that 3 + 2√5 is irrational.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Let 3 + 2√5 = a/b => √5 = (a - 3b)/(2b). Irration = Rational contradiction. Hence 3 + 2√5 is irrational.

questions.question_text: Explain why 7 * 11 * 13 + 13 is a composite number.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: 7 * 11 * 13 + 13 = 13(77 + 1) = 13 * 78, which has factors other than 1 and itself.

questions.question_text: Prove that √5 is irrational.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Assume √5 = a/b (coprime). 5b^2 = a^2 => 5 divides a => a = 5c => b^2 = 5c^2 => 5 divides b. Contradiction to coprime. Hence √5 is irrational.

questions.question_text: Sonia takes 18 min and Ravi takes 12 min to complete a lap. If they start together, after how many minutes will they meet at starting point?
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Time = LCM(18, 12) = 36 minutes.

questions.question_text: The total number of prime factors of 144 is:

Find HCF(96, 404) and use it to find LCM(96, 404).
Prove that 1/√2 is irrational.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: 1/√2 = √2 / 2. If rational, √2 would be rational, contradiction.

questions.question_text: Prove that √3 is irrational.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Assume √3 = a/b (coprime). 3b^2 = a^2 => 3 divides a => a = 3c => b^2 = 3c^2 => 3 divides b. Contradiction! Hence √3 is irrational.

questions.question_text: A shopkeeper has 420 kaju barfis and 130 badam barfis. Find maximum barfis per stack for equal stacks taking least area.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: HCF(420, 130) = 10 barfis per stack.

The exponent of 5 in prime factorisation of 3750 is:
Prove that 7√5 is irrational.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: 7√5 = a/b => √5 = a/(7b). Irrational = Rational contradiction.

questions.question_text: Find greatest number dividing 2053 and 967 leaving remainder 5 and 7.
Prove that 6 + √2 is irrational.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: 6 + √2 = a/b => √2 = (a - 6b)/b. Contradiction!

questions.question_text: Three bells toll together at intervals of 9, 12, 15 minutes. After how long will they toll together next?
questions.marking_scheme_answer: LCM(9, 12, 15) = 180 minutes = 3 hours.

questions.question_text: LCM of smallest 2-digit composite number and smallest composite number is:
Check whether 4^n can end with digit 0 for any natural number n.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: 4^n = 2^(2n). Prime factor 5 missing, so never ends in 0.

questions.question_text: Find HCF and LCM of 6 and 20.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: HCF = 2, LCM = 60.

questions.question_text: Prove that 2 - 3√5 is an irrational number.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: 2 - 3√5 = a/b => √5 = (2b - a)/(3b). Irrational = Rational contradiction.

questions.question_text: A school has 288 boys and 384 girls. Find maximum students per equal single-gender group.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Max per group = HCF(288, 384) = 96 students.

If α, β are zeroes of x^2 - 6x + a, find a if 3α + 2β = 20.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: α + β = 6 => 2α + 2β = 12. Subtracting from 3α + 2β = 20 gives α = 8. Then β = -2. a = αβ = -16.

questions.question_text: A fountain spray forms a parabola y = -x^2 + 4x. Find max height and distance where water hits ground.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Zeroes: x(-x+4) = 0 => x = 0, 4. Hits ground at 4 m. Max height at x = 2 is y = -4 + 8 = 4 m.

A company profit is p(x) = -2x^2 + 12x - 10 (x in thousands). Find break-even points.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: -2(x^2 - 6x + 5) = 0 => (x-1)(x-5) = 0 => x = 1 thousand and x = 5 thousand units.
